job.title: Videographer
job.description:
Available in October? We’re looking for a talented Video Editor to jump into a busy in-house creative team for a leading retail brand.
You’ll be creating short-form video advertising for paid social, alongside organic content — turning briefs, raw footage and existing assets into fast, engaging creative for Meta, TikTok and Instagram.
What we’re looking for
  • Around 2–5 years’ video editing experience
  • Strong short-form and social editing skills
  • A good instinct for hooks, pacing and what stops the scroll
  • Comfortable creating ad variations, cut-downs, captions and simple motion
  • Experience with paid social/performance creative is a big plus
  • Retail, eCommerce or consumer brand experience is great, but not essential
  • Ability to shoot simple social content is a bonus
You don’t need a huge commercial showreel. We’re looking for someone confident, creative, quick and genuinely good at social.
Interested and available in October? Send through your portfolio/social work, or reel.

job.title: Midweight Designer - Retail
job.description:
Based in Alexandria, our client is seeking a Junior to Midweight Graphic Designer to join the in-house team of a well-known Australian retail brand on an exciting 6-month full-time contract.
Working across a range of digital and print campaigns, you’ll collaborate with an established creative team to deliver engaging, high-quality creative across multiple channels.
  
Essential requirements include:
  • A strong retail-focused background
  • Experience creating campaigns across social, digital banners and eDMs
  • Comfortable rolling out creative across multiple formats
  • Proficiency in Figma, digital design and print
  • Must have your own Mac laptop
This is a hybrid role based in Alexandria, so you’ll need to be available to work onsite as part of the team. Fully remote candidates will not be considered.
  
It’s a great opportunity to join a collaborative, fast-growing Australian retail brand for 6 months, working across a variety of exciting campaigns and building valuable in-house experience.
This role is ideal for a Junior to Midweight Designer who enjoys variety and collaboration and wants to be part of a friendly, creative team.
  
Apply with your resume and portfolio.
